title: nltl shape
description: A named shape: an ordered list of XY points in screen orientation (origin top-left, y increases downward). Closed shapes (the default) need at least 3 points; open shapes at least 2.

$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loaders.

name.description: Unique across shapes/ and equal to the file name without .json.

closed.description: Whether the last point joins back to the first. Defaults to true (a polygon).
